mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.supplier_id, ss.project_id, ss.project_subject_id, ss.offer_detail_id, ss.is_follow, ss.winning_time FROM project_tendering_supplier ptr LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = ptr.project_tendering_id AND br.round = (SELECT MAX(ROUND) FROM bidding_rounds WHERE project_id = ptr.project_tendering_id ) LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = ptr.id AND ors.offer_round = br.round and ors.project_tendering_id = ptr.project_tendering_id RIGHT JOIN supplier_subject ss ON ss.`supplier_id` = ptr.id AND ss.`project_id` = ptr.project_tendering_id AND ss.`is_follow` IS NULL WHERE ptr.project_tendering_id = #{id} AND ptr.bid_status = 1 AND ors.`bid_gross_amount` IS NULL OR ors.is_hold = 1

SELECT ptr.id, bs.name AS supplierName, -- 供应商名称 ptr.project_tendering_id, -- 项目id ptr.source, -- 供应商来源 br.round, -- 轮次 br.bid_deadline, -- 投标截止时间 br.bid_opening_time, -- 开标时间 ors.bid_gross_amount, -- 报价总金额 ors.offer_time , -- 报价时间 ors.remark, -- 报价说明 ors.is_hold AS isHold, -- 报价是否暂存 ors.ip_address, -- 用户报价时的ip地址 ors.deposit_url, -- 保证金回单附件url ors.deposit_name -- 保证金回单附件名称 FROM project_tendering_supplier ptr LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = ptr.project_tendering_id AND br.round IN (SELECT DISTINCT ssr.`round` FROM supplier_subject_round ssr WHERE ssr.project_id = ptr.project_tendering_id AND ssr.supplier_id = ptr.id) LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = ptr.id AND ors.offer_round = br.round AND ors.project_tendering_id = ptr.project_tendering_id LEFT JOIN supplier bs ON bs.id = ptr.bid_supplier_id WHERE ptr.project_tendering_id = #{id} AND ptr.id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY br.round

SELECT ps.id, -- 招标科目表id ps.subject_names, -- 科目组合名称 ps.unit_name, -- 单位名称 ps.specification, -- 规格 ps.model_number, -- 型号 ps.mete, -- 采购量 ps.remark , -- 备注 ps.status, -- 科目状态 ord.is_follow, -- 供应商是否中标(当前轮次) ord.bid_amount, -- 报价金额 ord.unit_price, -- 单价 ssr.round FROM supplier_subject_round ssr LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = ssr.supplier_id AND ors.offer_round = ssr.round AND ors.project_tendering_id = ssr.project_id LEFT JOIN project_subject ps ON ps.id = ssr.project_subject_id LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail ord ON ord.offer_id = ors.id AND ord.project_subject_id = ps.id WHERE ssr.project_id = #{id} AND ssr.supplier_id = #{supplierId}

SELECT ptr.id, ss.name AS supplierName, -- 供应商名称 sd.short_name, -- 供应商简称 sd.contact_phone AS phone, -- 供应商联系方式 ptr.project_tendering_id, -- 项目id ptr.source, -- 供应商来源 br.round, -- 轮次 br.bid_deadline, -- 投标截止时间 br.bid_opening_time, -- 开标时间 ors.bid_gross_amount, -- 报价总金额 ors.offer_time , -- 报价时间 ors.remark, -- 报价说明 ors.is_hold, -- 报价是否暂存 ors.ip_address, -- 用户报价时的ip地址 ors.deposit_url, -- 保证金回单附件url ors.deposit_name -- 保证金回单附件名称 FROM project_tendering_supplier ptr LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = ptr.project_tendering_id LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = ptr.id AND ors.offer_round = br.round AND ors.project_tendering_id = ptr.project_tendering_id AND ors.is_hold = 0 LEFT JOIN supplier_detail sd on sd.supplier_id = ptr.bid_supplier_id LEFT JOIN supplier ss on ss.id = ptr.bid_supplier_id WHERE ptr.project_tendering_id = #{id} ORDER BY br.round DESC

SELECT ps.id, -- 主键id ps.subject_id, -- 科目id ps.subject_names AS subjectNames, -- 品名 bs.name AS subjectName, -- 末级科目名称 ps.specification , -- 规格 ps.model_number, -- 型号 ps.mete , -- 采购量 ps.unit_name AS unitName, -- 单位 ps.status, -- 状态 ifnull(COUNT(DISTINCT odsTwo.offer_id),0) tickSizeNum, -- 当前轮次报价单位数量 ifNULL(os.supplier_id,-1) AS supplierId , -- 拟中标单位id ss.name AS supplierName, -- 拟中标单位名称 sd.contact_person, -- 联系人 sd.contact_phone, -- 联系人电话 ods.unit_price AS unitPrice, -- 单价 ods.bid_amount AS bidAmount -- 总价 FROM project_subject ps LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail ods ON ods.project_subject_id = ps.`id` AND ods.project_id = ps.`project_id` AND ods.is_follow = 1 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds os ON os.`id` = ods.offer_id and os.project_tendering_id = ps.`project_id` LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier ptr ON ptr.`id` = os.`supplier_id` and ptr.project_tendering_id = ps.`project_id` LEFT JOIN supplier ss ON ss.id = ptr.bid_supplier_id LEFT JOIN supplier_detail sd ON sd.supplier_id = ptr.bid_supplier_id -- 当前轮次报价单位量 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds osTwo ON osTwo.project_tendering_id = ps.project_id AND osTwo.offer_round = (SELECT MAX(ROUND) FROM bidding_rounds WHERE project_id = ps.project_id) AND osTwo.is_hold = 0 LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail odsTwo ON odsTwo.project_subject_id = ps.`id` AND odsTwo.bid_amount IS NOT NULL AND odsTwo.offer_id = osTwo.id and odsTwo.project_id = ps.`project_id` LEFT JOIN subject bs ON bs.id = ps.subject_id WHERE ps.`project_id` = #{projectId} GROUP BY ps.id,os.id,ods.id,bs.id,ss.id,sd.id

SELECT ps.`id`, -- 招标科目表id ps.`subject_names`, -- 品名 bs.name AS subjectName, -- 末级科目名称 ps.mete, -- 采购量 ps.unit_name, -- 单位名称 ps.specification , -- 规格 ps.model_number, -- 型号 ors.offer_round AS round, -- 当前轮次 s.name AS supplierName, -- 供应商名称 sd.short_name, -- 供应商简称 ptr.id AS supplierId, -- 供应商关联表id ods.`bid_amount`, -- 报价金额 ods.`unit_price`, -- 单价 ods.id AS offerDetailId, -- 报价详情表id ss.is_follow -- 供应商--招标科目关联结果 FROM project_subject ps LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier ptr ON ptr.`project_tendering_id` = ps.project_id AND ptr.`bid_status` = 1 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = ptr.id AND ors.offer_round = #{round} AND ors.project_tendering_id = ps.project_id AND ors.is_hold = 0 LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail ods ON ods.`offer_id` = ors.`id` AND ods.`project_subject_id` = ps.`id` and ods.project_id = ps.project_id LEFT JOIN supplier_subject ss on ss.supplier_id = ptr.id and ss.project_subject_id = ps.id and ss.project_id = ps.project_id LEFT JOIN subject bs on bs.id = ps.subject_id LEFT JOIN supplier_detail sd on sd.supplier_id = ptr.bid_supplier_id LEFT JOIN supplier s on s.id = ptr.bid_supplier_id WHERE ps.`project_id` = #{projectId} and ps.status = 0 and ptr.result = 0 AND ors.bid_gross_amount is not null

SELECT DISTINCT ps.id, -- 招标科目表id ps.`subject_names`, -- 品名 bs.name AS subjectName, -- 末级科目名称 ps.unit_name, -- 单位名称 ps.mete, -- 采购量 ps.specification , -- 规格 ps.model_number, -- 型号 psd.round, -- 当前轮次 -- 供应商报价信息 s.name AS supplierName, -- 供应商名称 sd.short_name, -- 供应商简称 ptr.id AS supplierId, -- 供应商关联表id ods.bid_amount, -- 报价金额 ods.unit_price, -- 单价 ss.is_follow -- 供应商--招标科目关联结果 FROM project_subject_round psd LEFT JOIN project_subject ps ON ps.id = psd.project_subject_id AND ps.project_id = psd.project_id LEFT JOIN subject bs ON bs.id = ps.subject_id -- 供应商报价信息 LEFT JOIN supplier_subject_round ssr ON ssr.project_id = psd.project_id AND ssr.round = psd.round LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier ptr ON ptr.project_tendering_id = psd.project_id AND ptr.id = ssr.supplier_id AND ptr.bid_status = 1 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = ptr.id AND ors.offer_round = psd.round AND ors.project_tendering_id = psd.project_id AND ors.bid_gross_amount IS NOT NULL AND ors.is_hold = 0 LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail ods ON ods.offer_id = ors.id AND ods.project_subject_id = ps.id and ods.project_id = psd.project_id LEFT JOIN supplier s on s.id = ptr.bid_supplier_id LEFT JOIN supplier_detail sd on sd.supplier_id = ptr.bid_supplier_id LEFT JOIN supplier_subject ss ON ss.supplier_id = ptr.id AND ss.project_subject_id = ps.id and ss.project_id = psd.project_id WHERE psd.project_id = #{projectId} order by psd.round

SELECT ps.id, -- 招标科目表id ps.subject_names, -- 品名 ps.mete, -- 采购量 ps.unit_name, -- 单位名称 ps.specification , -- 规格 ps.model_number, -- 型号 ss.is_follow, -- 结果 ord.bid_amount, -- 报价金额 ord.unit_price -- 单价 FROM project_subject ps LEFT JOIN supplier_subject ss on ss.project_subject_id = ps.id AND ss.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND ss.is_follow is not null AND ss.project_id = ps.`project_id` LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail ord on ord.id = ss.offer_detail_id WHERE ps.`project_id` = #{projectId}

SELECT ssr.`supplier_id`, -- 供应商-项目关联表id ss.`is_follow`, -- 供应商投标结果 ssr.`project_subject_id`, -- 投标科目 ssr.`project_id` -- 项目id FROM project_tendering_supplier pts LEFT JOIN supplier_subject_round ssr ON ssr.`supplier_id` = pts.`id` AND ssr.`project_id` = pts.`project_tendering_id` LEFT JOIN supplier_subject ss ON ss.`project_id` = ssr.`project_id` AND ss.`supplier_id` = ssr.`supplier_id` AND ss.`project_subject_id` = ssr.`project_subject_id` LEFT JOIN offer_rounds ors ON ors.supplier_id = pts.id AND ors.offer_round = ssr.round and ors.project_tendering_id = pts.project_tendering_id WHERE pts.`project_tendering_id` = #{projectId} AND pts.`bid_status` = 1 AND ssr.`round` = #{round} AND ors.is_hold = 0
